errors.evidence: The pie chart contains eight slices, not seven. The description itself later lists eight themes, which is contradictory.
The blue slice represents '体育' (Sports) but its value is 4%, not 21%. The 21% slice is dark blue and corresponds to '科学' (Science).
The dark blue slice represents '科学' (Science) but its value is 21%, not 14%. The 14% slices correspond to '文化' (Culture) and '环境保护' (Environmental Protection).
The brown slice represents '环境保护' (Environmental Protection) but its value is 14%, not 4%. The 4% slice corresponds to '体育' (Sports).
